about: Policy for locating a maker's own official website (G decision 2026-11-18 14:00). Edited only by a reviewed G-maintained change. allowlist is G's optional list of extra official hosts for a maker and starts empty: discovery does not need it.

search.purpose: locate only: results give candidate addresses, never facts

own_site_signals: copyright or footer line naming the maker
about or our-story page on the same registered domain
official_site.unique_candidate: exactly one registered domain passes; two or more passing, or none, is not confident
extra_evidence_not_proof: domain contains a folded token of the maker name

fetch.reuse: hass.maker_site safeguards (robots.txt, public addresses, deadline, redirects, byte limits, no cookies)

deny_note: A cheap pre-filter for pages that are never a maker's own site. It is not identity: a domain missing from this list still has to pass every official_site check.
